0022600161.text: The Knicks (2-4, 1-2 at home) host the winless Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak) in their seventh game of the season, with New York sitting 11th in the East and 3 games back in the Atlantic while Brooklyn is 15th in the East and 4.5 back. Jose Alvarado is out for New York with an ankle sprain, and Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, and their last meeting, on March 20, 2026 in Brooklyn, ended 93-92 in New York's favor.
